title: Air pollution in the shadow of global crises: lessons from a small city in the Western Balkans
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00116A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Albinota Nuredini, Omid Ghaffarpasand, Dimitrios Bousiotis, Francis D. Pope
This study investigates how energy disruption, COVID-19, geopolitical instability, and rapid energy transitions, shaped air quality outcomes in Kičevo, a small city in the understudied pollution landscape of the Western Balkans.
